std.K-C5.0.1: Describe situations in which they demonstrated self-discipline and individual responsibility.
std.K-C2.0.2: Explain why people do not have the right to do whatever they want.

std.K–G2.0.1: Identify and describe places in the immediate environment.
std.1–H2.0.5: Identify the events or people celebrated during U.S. national holidays and why we celebrate them.
std.1–G2.0.1: Distinguish between physical and human characteristics of places.
std.1–E1.0.1: Distinguish between producers and consumers of goods and services.

std.1–E1.0.2: Describe ways in which families consume goods and services.

std.2–H2.0.3: Explain how individuals and groups have made significant historical changes.
